abstract.para: To change kernel boot parameters persistently for all subsequent boot processes, use the update-bootloader command as root or a user with equivalent administrative privileges.

tip.title: Test before making a change permanent
tip.para: On a production system, test the parameter temporarily first, as described in . Confirm it has the effect you expect before committing to a change that applies to every subsequent boot.

example.title: Permanently modify kernel boot parameters using update-bootloader
example.para: As an example of modifying kernel boot parameters permanently, we disable the splash screen that appears during boot.

warning.para: Before modifying kernel boot parameters, create a copy of the existing stable &grub; configuration (/etc/default/grub) somewhere outside of your system. If the boot loader gets corrupted, or you face problems after booting, your system might fail to start. The backup lets you compare and restore the last known working configuration.

step.para: Log in as root, or switch to a user with equivalent administrative privileges.
Check whether the parameter you want to change is already set:
The command prints the currently configured value, for example splash=silent.
Remove the parameter from the default boot options:

To add or change a parameter instead of removing one, use update-bootloader --add-option PARAMETER=VALUE. Setting an already-present parameter again replaces its value rather than adding a duplicate entry.
Apply the change to the boot loader configuration:
Reboot to confirm the splash screen no longer appears.

example.para: After executing the procedure and rebooting the system, we do not observe any splash screen for all subsequent boot processes.

note.title: Editing the &grub; configuration file directly
note.para: update-bootloader works consistently across the boot loaders &sle; supports, including &grub; and the systemd-boot preview. If you prefer to edit /etc/default/grub directly instead, see for the variables to modify and the command required to apply the change.
